source.title: From data chaos to physically interpretable deterministic mapping

cards.observed_relation: The reported structured operator-learning framework combines scale-resolved decomposition, sparse projection, and cross-view consistency across perturbed observations to improve stable interpretable recovery of governing dynamics under noise and distribution shift.
cards.transferable_relation: An inferred dynamical relation is methodologically stronger when it remains structurally consistent across deliberately perturbed observation views rather than fitting only one admitted representation.
admissible_assays: Perturb the observation view while holding the latent forward process fixed and test whether the inferred relation remains stable without receiving hidden-state leakage.
alternative_explanations: Cross-view agreement may reflect shared model regularization or correlated perturbations rather than uniquely identified latent dynamics.
falsifiers: The inferred structural relation changes materially under admissible observation perturbations while predictive fit remains superficially high.
forbidden_inferences: Cross-view stability does not prove that an inferred equation or TD613 mechanism is the unique true physical governing law.

source.title: Koopman Representations for Non-Vanishing Time Intervals: An Optimization Approach and Sampling Effects

cards.observed_relation: The preprint analyzes Koopman representations from observations at non-vanishing time intervals, identifies aliasing induced by oscillatory dynamics and sampling pattern, and reports that irregular sampling can break aliases through phase cancellation.
cards.transferable_relation: Indistinguishability can be created by the observation schedule itself; changing the admitted sampling pattern can sometimes recover distinctions without changing the underlying dynamics.
admissible_assays: Hold the forward process fixed while varying only a predeclared observation schedule or aperture, then measure candidate collisions separately from forward-state collisions.
alternative_explanations: A gain from irregular observation may be specific to oscillatory structure, optimization geometry, or the candidate frequency family rather than a generic anti-aliasing effect.
falsifiers: Changing only the declared observation pattern fails to alter aliases attributed to sampling, or apparent recovery requires changing the forward dynamics as well.
forbidden_inferences: Sampling-induced aliasing in Koopman estimation does not establish TD613 curvature, holonomy, or a physical oscillatory spectrum.

source.title: Mitigating State Aliasing in Vision-Language-Action Models via Inverse Dynamics Learning

cards.observed_relation: The preprint identifies state aliasing when learned visual representations are insensitive to subtle state distinctions required for different actions and uses inverse-dynamics supervision to encourage more state-discriminative features.
cards.transferable_relation: A representation can destroy distinctions needed by a downstream inverse or control task even when those distinctions exist in the underlying state; representation design can therefore change practical identifiability.
admissible_assays: Hold underlying terminal states fixed while comparing a rich representation with a deliberately lossy representation and measure which latent distinctions survive.
alternative_explanations: Representation gains may be benchmark-specific or arise from additional supervision rather than a general solution to state aliasing.
falsifiers: A purportedly richer representation does not reduce held-out state collisions or a lossy representation performs identically on the distinctions required by the downstream task.
forbidden_inferences: Reduced representation aliasing in robot learning does not establish latent physical geometry or unique state ontology in TD613.

source.title: Data-driven sensor placement for predictive applications: a Correlation-Assisted Attribution Framework (CAAF)

cards.observed_relation: The study reports that highly correlated candidate sensors can receive redundant feature-attribution importance and introduces correlation-aware clustering to select diverse representative sensors before prediction and attribution.
cards.transferable_relation: A larger set of nominal probes can contain overlapping information; dependence-aware probe selection is needed before probe count is interpreted as measurement diversity.
admissible_assays: Match total probe count or reading budget while varying correlation/redundancy among probe positions and compare reconstruction or predictive performance.
alternative_explanations: Clustering may improve performance through regularization or computational simplification rather than information diversity alone.
falsifiers: Dependence-aware selection offers no advantage over equally sized correlated selections under matched prediction targets and budgets.
forbidden_inferences: Correlation-aware sensor placement does not by itself establish statistical independence among TD613 probes or validate a Fisher-information claim.
